properties.areaDesc: Ouray, CO; San Juan, CO; San Miguel, CO
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 23 at 5:57AM MDT until October 23 at 8:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...South Central Ouray County in southwestern Colorado...
North Central San Juan County in southwestern Colorado...
East Central San Miguel County in southwestern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 800 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 556 AM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in
the warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Telluride, Mountain Village, Ouray, Ophir, Camp Bird and Red Mtn.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Low water crossings in mountainous terrain can become dangerous in
heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate
route.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 AM MDT THIS MORNING

properties.areaDesc: La Plata, CO
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 23 at 5:56AM MDT until October 23 at 8:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall
continues.

* WHERE...Southeastern La Plata County in southwestern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 800 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding with road washouts also occurring.
Streams and dry washes continue to rise due to excess runoff from
earlier rainfall.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 555 AM MDT, local law enforcement reported flooding in the
warned area.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Spring Creek, Salt Creek, Pinos River, Los, Little Bear Creek,
Dry Creek, Hayden Creek, Rock Creek, Ute Creek, Florida River,
Beaver Creek, Bear Creek and Crowbar Creek.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Bayfield, Ignacio, Oxford, Tiffany and Allison.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 AM MDT THIS MORNING
